publicApi.title: Community API
publicApi.intro: All STARVEIN reference data — ores, occurrences, signatures, locations, refinery yields and prices — is available as a free read-only REST API.

quickstart.title: Quickstart
quickstart.step1: Sign in with Discord — free; browsing the site itself never requires an account.
quickstart.step2: Create a key under "API keys" in the user menu. The full key is shown exactly once — copy it right away.
quickstart.step3: Send requests with the key as a bearer token (or as an x-api-key header):

limits.title: Rate limit
limits.text: 120 requests per minute per key. Every response carries X-RateLimit-Limit, -Remaining and -Reset; 429 responses add Retry-After.

envelope.title: Response format
envelope.text: All responses are wrapped in { data, meta } — meta.patchVersion tells you which game patch the data belongs to.
